framework.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria evidence crosswalk
framework.framework_edition: 2017 Trust Services Criteria (With Revised Points of Focus – 2022)
framework.content_use_notice: AICPA Trust Services Criteria identifiers are referenced for an original evidence crosswalk. Criterion text is not reproduced; consult the licensed official source and its terms of use.

controls.title: Observed logical-access activity
controls.mapping_note: Agent-strace-authored crosswalk for recorded tool access and sensitive-resource classifications; this label is not AICPA criterion wording.

controls.title: Observed identity context
controls.mapping_note: Agent-strace-authored crosswalk for persisted actor attribution and identity coverage; this label is not AICPA criterion wording.

controls.title: Identity and access lifecycle telemetry
controls.mapping_note: Agent-strace does not currently capture identity or access removal and modification lifecycle evidence. Per-call authorization is deliberately not treated as evidence for this criterion; this label is not AICPA criterion wording.

controls.title: Observed network-boundary activity
controls.mapping_note: Agent-strace-authored crosswalk for network operations visible in tool telemetry; this label is not AICPA criterion wording.

controls.title: Observed restricted-data movement signals
controls.mapping_note: Agent-strace-authored crosswalk for sensitive-resource and external-network combinations; this label is not AICPA criterion wording.

controls.title: Observed monitoring and trace-integrity evidence
controls.mapping_note: Agent-strace-authored crosswalk for event-result coverage and local hash-chain state; local chains are not independently anchored. This label is not AICPA criterion wording.

controls.title: Observed evaluation of security-event signals
controls.mapping_note: Agent-strace-authored crosswalk for recorded denials, errors, and repeated-failure patterns; this label is not AICPA criterion wording.

controls.title: Observed change activity and authorization context
controls.mapping_note: Agent-strace-authored crosswalk for file-change or code-execution operations and their authorization basis; this label is not AICPA criterion wording.
